ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var doc=org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result), baseUrl);
var as=doc.select('ul.chapter li a,#list dd a');
var seen={};
var arr=[];
for(var i=0;i<as.size();i++){
  var a=as.get(i);
  var u=String(a.attr('href'));
  var n=String(a.text());
  if(u!='' && !seen[u]){
    seen[u]=1;
    arr.push({name:n,url:u});
  }
}
JSON.stringify(arr)
</js>
